cards.title: The dense work-tool profile
cards.default: (default + heuristic) An item is skipped when its question is answered, its dial or value is set, overridden or locked, a chosen style direction (Q-dir-01) sets its dial, or a brand color decides it. A person who confirms a value records it with `--set-by confirmed_default`, and then it is theirs. The trigger and the item list are in levers.json, so the profile can be changed without touching engine code [inferred].

cards.title: Corners in dense work tools
cards.block: Foundations > Shape > Radius scale and default
cards.default: (default + heuristic) for a dense work tool that has not chosen its corners, use 6 / 8 / 12. Keep 0-2 px only when the person chooses it. The floor value is [inferred]. Small badges stay on radius.detail (2 px at a 6 px control). The study saw about 4 px badges, which is not built yet.

cards.title: Three weights, with labels at 500
cards.default: (default + heuristic) three weights in a dense tool unless Q-type-12 is answered. At most three weights per screen (study P11b).

cards.title: One colored accent for selection, links and focus
cards.default: (default + heuristic) never ship grey for selection, links and focus. Use the stand-in blue until there is a brand color. This is not a brand hue: it is the same placeholder the engine already uses at Colorfulness 11 and up. The floor value is [inferred]. Command palettes may still highlight the active row in grey [S-L23-001, section 2.7].

cards.title: Hairlines for static surfaces, shadows for floating ones
cards.block: Foundations > Depth > Elevation; Foundations > Color > Borders
cards.default: (default + heuristic) never a shadow on an in-flow static surface in a dense tool, and always one on a floating layer. The separator step is [inferred].

cards.title: Row heights for lists and tables
cards.default: (default + heuristic) md for most tables, sm for dense data grids, two-line when a cell has a title and a meta line. The offsets are [inferred]: they fit Carbon's sizes at 32 px controls (sm is 4 px over Carbon's 32, toward the study's 34-36) and the study's ranges.

cards.title: Tabular digits by default
cards.default: (default + heuristic) tabular digits in tables, ledgers, timers and counters, never in running text.
